info.software: Real-time GitHub star counts, total repository volume, and 30-day momentum metrics for programming languages, popular frameworks, libraries, and database technologies.
info.security: GitHub star trends and community activity stats for top open-source cybersecurity tools and frameworks (Ghidra, Metasploit, Nmap, OWASP ZAP, etc.). These tools are provided for educational and research purposes within ethical and legal boundaries (security research, pentesting, CTF challenges, and system defense).

showcase.languagesDesc: Real-time GitHub usage, repository volume, and popularity momentum for the most adopted technologies across system, web, and AI.
showcase.frameworksDesc: Real-time developer adoption and release momentum metrics for modern application libraries such as React, Next.js, FastAPI, and Vue.
showcase.databasesDesc: Production adoption rates and live repository statistics for relational, NoSQL, in-memory, and search engine database technologies.
showcase.secOffensiveDesc: Community momentum for open-source tools utilized in reverse engineering, penetration testing, and exploit research.
showcase.secDefensiveDesc: Container scanning, static application security testing (SAST/DAST), and secure development lifecycle tooling.
showcase.secStackDesc: Global tools applied across ethical security research, CI/CD pipeline defense, and CTF competitions.
